Inventory Officer Job at Zetile Stores Limited




        
    

        
        Zetile Stores Limited is a fast-growing, 24-hour supermarket chain based in Lekki, Lagos, committed to delivering a seamless, premium retail experience to customers at every hour of the day. As part of the Zetile Group, the Store is built on the values of reliability, quality, and exceptional customer service setting it apart as a trusted neighborhood destination on the Island.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Officer
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. + 1 compulsory Saturday monthly 

Freejob posting

 
     

            
    



Key Responsibilities


	Monitor and maintain accurate records of all inventory received, stored, transferred, issued, returned, damaged, or expired.
	Receive and verify deliveries against purchase orders and relevant documents, identifying and reporting quantity, quality, or delivery discrepancies.
	Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile physical stock with system records, investigating and reporting variances.
	Monitor stock levels, including low-stock, out-of-stock, overstocked, fast-moving, and slow-moving products, and provide timely updates to Procurement and Management.
	Monitor product expiry dates, implement FEFO principles where applicable, and ensure expired or damaged products are properly identified and documented.
	Maintain accurate inventory records and update the ERP or inventory management system for all stock movements and authorized adjustments.
	Prepare inventory reports and work closely with Procurement, Supervisors, and Management to minimize stock losses, wastage, discrepancies, and stock-outs.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field and at least 1 year of relevant inventory, stock control, warehouse, retail, supermarket, or FMCG experience.
	Strong knowledge of inventory management, stock counting, and reconciliation.
	Experience using ERP, inventory management, or stock control systems.
	Good Microsoft Excel, numerical, analytical, and reporting skills.
	Strong attention to detail, integrity, organization, and ability to investigate and resolve stock discrepancies.


Remuneration


	Salary: N150,000 net monthly
	HMO: Provided upon succesful completion and confirmation of employment.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Inventory Officer" as subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Control Officer",
  "description": "Latins Security Company - We are a private security company, established by a team of highly skilled and dedicated security professionals to tackle and provide total security solutions for individuals as well as private and government organizations.&nbsp;

Latins Security Nigeria Limited is affiliated to Latins Security UK Limited (now Stone House Security Solutions Limited. As an independent company focused on providing quality security services, we pride ourselves on providing the highest quality security personnel and solutions that are tailored to our clients&rsquo; specific requirements.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Control Officer&nbsp;

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Controlling Officer will be responsible for monitoring and coordinating all security operations from the control room, including tracking patrol movements, managing radio/communication systems, responding to incidents in real time, and ensuring that all guards, drivers, and supervisors are properly deployed and accounted for at all times.
	The ideal candidate must be alert, decisive under pressure, and able to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor CCTV feeds, GPS/vehicle tracking systems, and communication channels to oversee real-time security operations.
	Maintain constant radio contact with patrol teams, guards, and supervisors on the ground.

	This role requires someone who is highly creative, analytical, and passionate about digital marketing and brand growth.

	Manage and grow Smart Nuel&#39;s presence on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X (Twitter), WhatsApp Business, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
